title: Front Desk Automation for Salons: Ultimate Guide

facts.fact: According to SchedulingKit, the U.S. salon industry earns roughly $48 billion annually.
facts.quote: The U.S. salon industry earns roughly $48 billion annually, with 87% of revenue from repeat clients, making retention key.

facts.fact: According to SchedulingKit, 71% of salons use digital booking software.
facts.quote: 71% of salons now use digital booking software, and those who adopted it saw 58% more new clients.

facts.fact: According to SchedulingKit, salons without automated reminders see a 20% no-show rate.
facts.quote: Salons without automated reminders see a 20% no-show rate, while automated SMS reminders cut that by 35%.

facts.fact: According to SchedulingKit, automated rebooking prompts boost salon revenue by 23%.
facts.quote: Automated rebooking prompts also boost revenue by 23%.

facts.fact: The guide states that most automation platforms offer tiered pricing based on salon size and call volume.
facts.quote: Most platforms offer tiered pricing based on salon size and call volume.

facts.fact: The guide recommends using a free trial or demo to confirm a front desk tool fits the existing calendar and client flow before committing.
facts.quote: Use a free trial or demo to confirm the tool fits your existing calendar and client flow.
